review_candidates.title: Senior Network Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: 🚀 Biz Kimiz & Neye İnanıyoruz ? İnternet eşitsizlikleri ortadan kaldırıyor. Bu yüzden biz herkesin birinci sınıf bir interneti hak ettiğine inanıyoruz ve kendi almak istediğimiz internet hizmetini sunmak için çalışıyoruz. Sektörümüzde sık rastlanan kotaları, taahhütleri, akıl karıştıran teklifleri, kurnaz fiyatlama oyunlarını sevmiyoruz. Onun için yapmıyoruz. Merakın, yaratıcılığın, düş kurmanın gücüne inanıyoruz. Hayal ettiklerimizi hayata geçirmek için, hayatı basitleştirmek için, herkesi yapabilir kılmak için teknolojiyi çok iyi kullanıyoruz. Teknolojinin üstüne inancımızı, inadımızı, alın terimizi koyuyoruz. Fikir doğruysa, yapılamazlara, edilemezlere, o işler öyle yürümezlere aldırış etmiyoruz. Hız tutkunuyuz. Türkiye’nin en hızlı internetini sunuyoruz ve çok daha hızlısını yapmanın peşindeyiz. Yani bu daha başlangıç. Hız tutkumuz internet hızıyla sınırlı değil. Dolambaçlı lafların, beyin yakan sözleşmelerin, şirket duvarlarının arkasına sığınmayı reddediyoruz. Bugün git yarın gel, biz biliriz sen bilmezsin, bizim çalışma şeklimiz değil. review_candidates.title: Network Security Engineer (5년 이상)
review_candidates.description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요 토스증권의 Network Security Engineer는 Network Engineer, IDC Manager와 함께 Network Engineering Team에 소속되어 있어요. 대고객 및 내부고객 전반에 대한 보안 네트워크 구축 및 지원을 위해 금융, 커머스, 포털, 게임사 등 여러 분야에서 모인 인프라, 개발 영역의 우수한 인재들과 협업하고 있어요. '제품에만 집중할 수 있도록 모든 것을 지원한다'라는 목표를 두고, 리테일 1위 증권사 규모의 용량을 지원할 수 있는 인프라 구축을 위해 노력하고 있어요. 더욱 빠른 제품 출시를 위해 자동화도 추진하고 있어요. 합류하면 함께 할 업무예요 온프레미스 및 클라우드 환경의 네트워크 보안 인프라를 구축하고 운영해요. VPC 설계, 인라인 트래픽 검사, 네트워크 세그멘테이션 등 보안 아키텍처의 설계와 구현에 참여해요. 대규모 트래픽이 흐르는 서비스망에서 Fortinet 등 글로벌 보안 장비 기반의 방화벽, VPN, DDoS 방어 장비, NPB 등을 운영하며, 모니터링과 장애 대응, 정책 변경을 통해 서비스 안정성을 높여요. API, Python, Terraform, Ansible 등을 활용해 방화벽 정책의 검증·배포·변경·폐기 과정과 반복적인 운영 업무를 자동화해요. 금융 분야 정보보호 요구사항에 따른 망 분리·접근 통제 정책을 적용하고, 운영 이력과 증적을 체계적으로 관리해요. AI 서비스와 GPU 워크로드의 통신을 파악해 트래픽 가시성과 보안 통제를 개선하고, AI 도구를 활용해 로그 분석과 정책 검토, 변경 영향 분석의 효율과 정확도를 높여요. 이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요 대규모 트래픽에 최적화된 보안 네트워크 아키텍처를 설계하고 구축한 경험이 필요해요. 방화벽 정책 분석, 최적화 및 유지 관리 업무를 수행한 경험이 필요해요. TCP/IP 프로토콜 이해도가 높고, 트러블슈팅을 위한 패킷 분석 경험이 필요해요. 네트워크 보안 장비의 API 연동이나 Script(Python 등) 작성으로 업무를 자동화하거나, 내부 운영 도구를 직접 개발한 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. IaC(Terraform, Ansible)로 네트워크·보안 정책을 형상 관리하고, 파이프라인에서 정책을 검증해본 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. 클라우드에서 인라인 보안 검사 구조(GWLB/Network Firewall, NVA, 서비스 체이닝)를 설계·구축해본 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. 컨테이너 환경(EKS, GKE)의 네트워크와 세그멘테이션(NetworkPolicy 등)을 이해하고 있다면 더욱 좋아요. Flow Log, 패킷 브로커, SSL 복호화 기반 분석 등으로 트래픽 가시성을 확보해본 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. AI/LLM을 활용해 보안 운영을 자동화해봤거나, AI 워크로드의 네트워크 통제를 고민해본 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. 금융정보 보호 관련 규정을 이해하고, 관련 구축 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요. 이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요 기술적인 문제 개선 (최적화, 오류 수정 등) 사례 중 가장 기억에 남는 것을 기술해 주세요. 기여한 프로젝트를 사례 중심으로 상세하게 기술해 주세요. (본인의 역할, 본인이 사용했던 기술스택, 프로젝트 전후 개선된 점 등) 토스증권으로의 합류여정 서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사 꼭 확인해 주세요 이력서 및 제출 서류에 허위 사실이 발견되거나 근무 이력 중 징계사항이 확인될 경우, 채용이 취소될 수 있어요. 토스증권 내규에 따라 채용금지자 또는 결격사유 해당자는 채용이 취소될 수 있어요. 장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 지원 시 관련법에 따라 우대하고 있어요. 함께할 동료를 위한 한마디 "토스증권 Infra팀에서는 저와 팀이 함께 성장하고 있음을 매번 느끼며 일할 수 있어요" 저는 방화벽 엔지니어로 운영을 경험해 오다가 토스팀에 합류하게 되었고, 현재는 고객과 팀을 보호하기 위한 네트워크 보안 장비를 구성하고 운영하며 안전한 네트워크를 만들기위해 노력하고 있어요. 기존의 수직적인 금융권의 특성상 폐쇄적인 네트워크 환경에서 제한된 업무를 수행해왔지만, 토스증권 Network Security Engineer로써는 다양한 보안 장비와 솔루션에 대한 경험을 할 기회가 있습니다. 그리고 팀과 고객에게 원활한 서비스 환경을 제공하기 위해 고민하고 실행하며 개인과 팀의 성장이 함께 이루어지는 것도 체감하실 수 있어요!

review_candidates.title: L3 Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Us At Logicalis Asia Pacific, this is where you belong, grow, and thrive — at one of APAC's leading AI-driven technology integrators. As the Architects of Change™, we combine global expertise with local insight to help organisations accelerate their journey toward becoming AI-ready enterprises. With 7,000+ professionals across 30 territories and more than 10,000 clients worldwide, we deliver lifecycle services across cloud, connectivity, collaboration, cybersecurity, and managed services — providing real-time visibility and intelligence across our clients' digital ecosystems. You'll belong as part of a collaborative regional team embedded within a global organisation. You'll grow through hands-on experience with the world's leading technology partners, supported by investment in certifications, consulting capability, and cross-border opportunity. And you'll thrive in a culture built on inclusion, trust, and continuous improvement. Logicalis is proud to be a Great Place to Work® Certified™ organisation across multiple APAC markets — because the commitment we bring to our clients belongs equally to our people. Join us and help shape the future of technology across APAC. Key Responsibilities L3 Network Support & Troubleshooting - Provide L3 technical support for complex network incidents escalated from L1/L2 teams. - Troubleshoot complex issues across LAN, WAN, Internet, WLAN, VPN, routing, switching, and firewall environments. - Perform detailed network analysis using logs, packet captures, routing tables and network monitoring tools. - Lead troubleshooting for major incidents and provide technical support during critical outages. - Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and identify permanent corrective actions. - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to L1/L2 network engineers. Network Infrastructure Management Provide hands-on support and administration across a multi-vendor network environment, including: - Cisco – Routers, switches, Catalyst, Nexus and related networking technologies. - Fortinet – FortiGate firewalls, VPN, security policies and FortiManager/FortiAnalyzer where applicable. - Palo Alto – Next-generation firewalls, security policies, VPN and related security technologies. - Juniper – Routers, switches and enterprise networking platforms. - UniFi – Wireless and LAN infrastructure. - Cisco Meraki – Switches, wireless access points, security appliances and cloud-managed networking. Routing & Switching - Configure and troubleshoot BGP, OSPF, VLAN, STP, VRF, trunking, LACP/EtherChannel and inter-VLAN routing. - Troubleshoot routing and connectivity issues across LAN, WAN and Internet environments. - Analyse routing paths and network traffic to identify performance and connectivity issues. - Support network redundancy, high availability and failover configurations. Firewall & Network Security - Configure, troubleshoot and maintain Fortinet and Palo Alto firewalls. - Support firewall policies, NAT, VPN, routing and security profiles. - Troubleshoot application connectivity and firewall-related issues. - Work closely with cybersecurity teams on network security requirements. - Review and implement firewall changes in accordance with approved change-management processes. Wireless & SD-WAN - Support enterprise wireless infrastructure across Cisco, Meraki, UniFi and other wireless platforms. - Troubleshoot wireless connectivity, authentication, coverage and performance issues. - Support SD-WAN and Internet connectivity where applicable. - Monitor network performance and proactively identify potential issues. Network Projects & Changes - Participate in network migration, upgrade, refresh and infrastructure improvement projects. - Perform network device upgrades, configuration changes and technology migrations. - Prepare implementation and rollback plans. - Conduct pre-change and post-change validation. - Coordinate with internal teams, vendors and stakeholders during network implementations. - Ensure all network changes are properly documented and communicated. Incident & Problem Management - Take ownership of complex network incidents through to resolution. - Participate in Major Incident Management and provide technical updates. - Perform detailed RCA for critical and recurring incidents. - Identify opportunities to improve network reliability and reduce recurring incidents. - Maintain technical knowledge articles and troubleshooting procedures. Required Technical Skills Networking - Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VLAN, STP, QoS, VPN and network security. - Strong hands-on experience with routing and switching. - Good knowledge of BGP and OSPF. - Strong troubleshooting skills using packet captures and network diagnostic tools. - Experience with network monitoring and management platforms. Vendor Technologies Cisco| Routing, switching, Catalyst/Nexus Fortinet| FortiGate, Firewall, VPN, Security Policies Palo Alto| NGFW, Security Policies, VPN, NAT Juniper| Routing, Switching and Troubleshooting Cisco Meraki| Switching, Wireless, Security Appliance UniFi| Switching, Wireless and Network Management Experience across multiple vendors is highly preferred. Qualifications & Experience - Diploma or Degree in IT, Computer Science, Networking or a related discipline. - 5–8+ years of network engineering experience, with strong L3 troubleshooting experience. - Hands-on experience supporting enterprise network environments. - Experience working in a multi-vendor network environment. - CCNP, JNCIP, Fortinet, Palo Alto or equivalent certifications are preferred. - ITIL experience and knowledge of Incident, Problem and Change Management processes. - Experience supporting regional or global environments is an advantage. Key Competencies - Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills. - Strong ownership and accountability. - Able to independently troubleshoot complex network issues. - Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. - Able to work effectively under pressure during major incidents. - Good documentation and reporting skills. - Proactive approach to network monitoring and problem prevention. - Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to L1/L2 engineers. Working Environment - Support enterprise and regional network infrastructure. - Participate in on-call and after-hours support - Support planned maintenance and network changes outside business hours. - Participate in Major Incident Management and technical bridge calls. - Work with regional/global teams across different time zones. - Occasional travel to offices or data centres may be required.

As the Architects of Change™, we combine global expertise with local insight to help organisations accelerate their journey toward becoming AI-ready enterprises. You'll belong as part of a collaborative regional team embedded within a global organisation. You'll grow through hands-on experience with the world's leading technology partners, supported by investment in certifications, consulting capability, and cross-border opportunity. And you'll thrive in a culture built on inclusion, trust, and continuous improvement. Logicalis is proud to be a Great Place to Work® Certified™ organisation across multiple APAC markets — because the commitment we bring to our clients belongs equally to our people. Join us and help shape the future of technology across APAC. The L3 System Engineer is responsible for providing advanced technical support, troubleshooting, administration, and engineering of enterprise server, virtualisation, storage, backup, and compute infrastructure. The role will act as the Level 3 technical escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents and problems. The engineer will provide technical leadership to L1/L2 teams and work closely with network, security, application, vendors, and regional infrastructure teams. The role will also support infrastructure projects, technology refreshes, migrations, upgrades, patching, capacity management, disaster recovery, and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Responsibilities 1. L3 Infrastructure Support - Provide L3 technical support for complex infrastructure incidents escalated from L1/L2 teams. - Troubleshoot complex server, virtualisation, storage, backup, and compute issues. - Perform detailed technical analysis of system logs, performance metrics, configurations, and infrastructure events. - Lead troubleshooting for major incidents and critical infrastructure outages. - Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and identify permanent corrective actions. - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to L1/L2 engineers. - Ensure incidents are resolved within agreed SLA. 2. VMware Virtualisation - Administer and troubleshoot enterprise VMware vSphere, ESXi and vCenter environments. - Support VMware clusters, HA, DRS, vMotion and virtual networking. - Troubleshoot VM CPU, memory, storage and network performance issues. - Perform ESXi host and VMware Tools upgrades. - Support VM provisioning, migration, snapshots and lifecycle management. - Troubleshoot ESXi host, vCenter and cluster-related issues. - Perform VMware capacity planning and resource optimisation. - Participate in VMware platform upgrades and migration projects. 3. Cisco UCS - Manage and troubleshoot Cisco UCS infrastructure. - Support UCS Manager, Fabric Interconnects, chassis, blades and service profiles. - Troubleshoot UCS connectivity, hardware, firmware and performance issues. - Perform UCS firmware upgrades and infrastructure maintenance. - Work with Cisco TAC on complex hardware and platform issues. - Support UCS integration with VMware and enterprise storage environments. 4. NetApp Storage - Manage and troubleshoot NetApp storage infrastructure. - Support storage provisioning, volumes, LUNs, aggregates and storage connectivity. - Troubleshoot storage performance, capacity and connectivity issues. - Support NFS, CIFS/SMB and SAN environments where applicable. - Monitor storage capacity and performance. - Perform storage configuration changes, upgrades and lifecycle activities. - Work with NetApp support on complex storage incidents. 5. Backup & Recovery NetBackup - Administer and troubleshoot Veritas NetBackup environments. - Troubleshoot backup failures, media issues, policy configuration and backup performance. - Monitor backup jobs and ensure backup compliance. - Perform backup and recovery troubleshooting. - Support backup infrastructure upgrades and maintenance. Veeam - Administer and troubleshoot Veeam Backup & Replication. - Configure and maintain backup jobs and policies. - Troubleshoot backup and replication failures. - Support VM recovery, file-level recovery and disaster recovery activities. - Monitor backup health and capacity. - Perform Veeam upgrades and infrastructure maintenance. 6. Disaster Recovery - Support enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) infrastructure and processes. - Participate in regular DR exercises and recovery testing. - Validate backup integrity and recovery capability. - Troubleshoot replication and recovery issues. - Maintain DR documentation, recovery procedures and runbooks. - Support business continuity and disaster recovery initiatives. 7. Server & Operating System Support - Support enterprise physical and virtual server infrastructure. - Troubleshoot Windows Server and infrastructure-related issues. - Support server provisioning, upgrades, patching and decommissioning. - Analyse CPU, memory, disk, network and OS performance. - Work with hardware vendors on server-related incidents. - Ensure servers comply with corporate security and configuration standards. 8. Infrastructure Patching & Upgrades - Plan and execute infrastructure patching and upgrade activities. - Perform VMware ESXi, VMware Tools, Cisco UCS and storage upgrades. - Coordinate patching activities with application and infrastructure owners. - Perform pre-change and post-change validation. - Develop implementation and rollback plans. - Ensure changes are implemented according to approved Change Management procedures. 9. Incident & Problem Management - Take ownership of complex and critical infrastructure incidents. - Participate in Major Incident Management and technical bridge calls. - Perform detailed RCA for critical and recurring incidents. - Identify permanent solutions to recurring infrastructure issues. - Maintain technical knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides. - Drive Problem Management activities to improve infrastructure stability. Technology| Required Skills VMware| vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, HA, DRS, vMotion, virtual networking Cisco UCS| UCS Manager, Fabric Interconnects, Blades, Service Profiles, Firmware NetApp| Storage, SAN/NAS, NFS, SMB, LUN, Capacity & Performance NetBackup| Backup policies, troubleshooting, recovery, media management Veeam| Backup & Replication, VM backup, recovery, replication Windows Server| Administration, troubleshooting, patching, performance PowerShell| Scripting and infrastructure automation Qualifications & Experience - Diploma or Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or related discipline. - 5–8+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure/system engineering. - Strong hands-on experience with VMware environments. - Hands-on experience with Cisco UCS. - Good experience with NetApp storage. - Strong experience with either NetBackup and/or Veeam. - Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or multi-site environments. - Experience with ITIL Incident, Problem and Change Management. - VMware VCP, Cisco, NetApp, Veeam or relevant infrastructure certifications are advantageous. Key Competencies - Strong L3 troubleshooting and analytical skills. - Excellent problem-solving capabilities. - Strong ownership and accountability. - Ability to independently troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues. - Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. - Ability to work under pressure during major incidents. - Strong documentation and reporting skills. - Proactive approach to infrastructure monitoring and improvement. Working Environment - Support enterprise and regional infrastructure environments. - Participate in on-call and after-hours support where required. - Support planned maintenance and infrastructure changes outside business hours. - Participate in Major Incident Management. - Work closely with network, security, application and vendor teams. - Support regional/global teams across different time zones. - Occasional travel to data centres or offices may be required. Interested applicants are invited to apply via our careers portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
